Dubai, as we know it today, has not been the same in the past. Today’s Dubai is a synonym of luxury and wealth. It has been one of the most loved tourist destinations for people from all over the world but this was not the case earlier. Once just a fisherman’s village, how did Dubai climbed to the peak of success is an interesting story. And it's not just the oil wells that made Dubai rich but the vision of its ruler. Let's discuss its past and present, and what all steps contributed to building today’s Dubai. What system and rules does Dubai follow and is everything as good as its looks.
